### Learning to Fight
Author: J.D. Greear
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/learning-to-fight
Passage: Judges 3:1-2
Points:
- Believers frequently question why God does not instantly remove trials, weaknesses, and temptations from their lives.
- According to Judges 3:1–2, God intentionally left enemy nations in Canaan so incoming generations would learn how to fight.
- The Lord leads His people into victory through struggle to keep them dependent on His grace rather than self-reliance.
- Enduring battles with sin protect Christians from the greater spiritual danger of pride and self-righteousness.
- Believers must not settle into complacency with sin, but fix their eyes on Christ's victory and fight.

### Bible Pathway - March 23
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-23-2013.html
Passage: Judges 3:4
Points:
- God allowed pagan nations to remain to test whether Israel would faithfully keep His commandments.
- Ignoring God's commands resulted in incremental compromise, moving from peaceful coexistence to intermarriage and idolatry.
- Spiritual compromise stripped Israel of God's protection and brought them into captivity to foreign oppressors.
- Even after severe backsliding, God mercifully hears the prayers of those who repent and seek His help.
- Afflictions serve a redemptive purpose when they turn our hearts back to the Lord and teach us to redeem our time.
